text: dsh-edge-search（DSH 插件，桌面和 CLI 客户端）：通过本机 Edge 浏览器和 CDP，为 DSH 提供网页搜索与网页正文读取工具。它在后台标签页打开搜索结果或指定网页，提取标题、链接、摘要或正文，再关闭标签页；搜索支持 Bing、Baidu、Google 和 DuckDuckGo，并可限制结果数或正文长度。适合内置网页工具不可用时，或希望用本机浏览器访问网页的 DSH 用户。需要 Windows 与 Edge（可指定其他 Chromium 浏览器），无需 API Key；浏览器会直接访问搜索引擎或目标网站。

dsh-edge-search adds web search and page reading to DSH through local Edge. It searches with Bing, Baidu, Google or DuckDuckGo, or reads a URL and returns readable text. Useful when built in web tools are unavailable. Requires Windows and Edge (or configured Chromium); no API key is needed.

dsh-edge-search 的功能「搜索网页」：执行 edge_search 时用指定搜索引擎打开查询结果页，提取结果标题、URL 和摘要并以文本返回；可设置引擎与结果数量。
dsh-edge-search 的功能「读取网页正文」：执行 edge_read 时打开 http/https URL，通过文本密度策略提取正文并返回文本；可设置最大字符数。
dsh-edge-search 的功能「复用专用 Edge 实例」：工具调用连接本机 CDP 端口，若 Edge 尚未运行则用独立 profile 启动，并用完关闭新建标签页。
dsh-edge-search 使用本机专用 Edge profile；页面请求由浏览器直接发往搜索引擎或目标站点，搜索词或目标 URL 会随请求发送。

@local/dsh-edge-search README · dsh-edge-search：简体中文 | [English](README.en.md)

一个 **DeepSeek Harness**（DSH）的 Host 插件，通过 CDP 驱动
**你本机真实的 Edge 浏览器**，给 agent 补上 `edge_search` / `edge_read` 两个工具。
不要 API Key，不接第三方服务，不花一分钱。

它的主业是**给内置 web 工具兜底**——尤其是你在开 VPN 的时候。

-->

---

@local/dsh-edge-search README · 为什么需要它：DSH 自带的 `web_fetch` 有一层 SSRF 防护：域名解析一次，**只要解析出的地址里有一个不是
公网单播，整批结果直接拒绝**，连请求都不发。

而 Clash / Mihomo 系 VPN 的 **fake-ip 模式**（默认池 `198.18.0.0/15`，RFC 2544 保留段）
会把**每一个**域名都解析成 `198.18.x.x`。两边一撞，`web_fetch` 在**所有站点**上都报：

```
URL hostname "..." resolves to a non-public IP address
```

这不是某个网站的问题，也不是你网络坏了——`curl`、浏览器、`Invoke-WebRequest` 都好好的，
只是 `web_fetch` 在发包之前就把自己拦住了。

本插件绕开这层检查：浏览器自己解析域名、自己开 socket，系统把流量送进 VPN 隧道，
插件只负责把渲染好的页面读回来。

@local/dsh-edge-search README · 两个工具：| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `edge_search` | 后台标签页打开搜索结果页，提取 `标题 / URL / 摘要`，然后关掉标签页。引擎支持 `bing`（默认）/ `baidu` / `google` / `duckduckgo` |
| `edge_read` | 后台标签页打开指定 URL，用文本密度策略提取正文（站点改版也不怕），然后关掉标签页 |

两个工具都**只返回纯文本、无状态**，不会碰你已打开的标签页，也**不需要登录**。

它们是**兜底通道，不是默认通道**：比 `web_fetch` 慢一个数量级，只在内置工具失败或你
不想花按次计费的搜索费时才用。

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `port` | `9222` | CDP 端口，必须没被占用 |
| `edgePath` | 自动探测 | `msedge.exe` 的路径。Edge 装在非标准位置时填；指向的文件不存在会直接报错，不会静默回退到自动探测 |

@local/dsh-edge-search README · 原理 / 一条必须知道的硬约束：```mermaid flowchart LR A["agent 调用 edge_read"] --> B["插件"] B --> C["启动 / 复用
独立 profile 的 Edge"] C --> D["新建后台标签页"] 关键在于：**DNS 解析和 socket 都在浏览器里完成**，不经过 DSH 那层 IP 校验。 这就是它能绕过 fake-ip 拦截的全部原因。 Chromium 136 起，浏览器用**默认数据目录**时会**静默忽略** `--remote-debugging-port`。 所以本插件永远带一个专用的 `--user-data-dir` 启动 Edge，而不是去接管你日常那个窗口。 别想着"优化"掉这个参数——去掉之后调试端口根本不会监听，而且**没有任何报错**。 每次调用都是新建一个后台标签页、干完活、关掉。你自己的窗口一律不碰。 ---
section: 原理 / 一条必须知道的硬约束

text:
@local/dsh-edge-search README · 安全说明：- **CDP 端口只监听 `127.0.0.1`**，不接受外部连接。但**本机上的任何进程**都能连上它——
  在共享电脑或不可信环境里需要留意。不用时直接关掉那个 Edge 窗口即可。
- **调试 profile 是独立的**，位于 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-edge-search\edge-profile`，
  不含你的书签、密码、Cookie 和登录态。这也是「读不到需要登录的页面」的原因——
  是设计，不是缺陷。
- 插件**不向任何第三方服务发送数据**，没有遥测、没有统计上报、没有 API Key。
  所有请求都是你的浏览器直接发往目标站点。

|---|---|---|
| `unknown tool "edge_read"` | 插件没加载 | 用方式一装的，先确认有没有**手动重启** DSH；还是不行就检查方式二的第 3 步（`bundles`） |
| `配置项 edgePath 指向的可执行文件不存在` | 路径写错 | 检查路径，或删掉该项让插件自动探测 |
| `Edge did not expose a debugger on port 9222` | 端口被占，或找不到 Edge | `Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 9222`；改 `port` / `edgePath` |
| 第一次调用要 5–10 秒 | 正在拉起 Edge | 正常。调试窗口别关，后续调用会复用它 |
| `extracted no readable text` | 纯 JS 应用 / 登录墙 / 空页面 | 不是 bug，确实没正文可提 |
| 要登录才看得到的内容 | 专用 profile 里没有你的 cookie | 设计如此，这种内容请用你自己的浏览器 |

@local/dsh-edge-search README · dsh-edge-search：English | [简体中文](README.md)

A **DeepSeek Harness** (DSH) host plugin that gives the agent two extra web tools —
`edge_search` and `edge_read` — by driving **your real Microsoft Edge** over the Chrome
DevTools Protocol. No search API key, no external service, no billing.

Its main job is being the **fallback when the built-in web tools stop working**, which happens
to everyone running a VPN in fake-ip mode.

<!-- Screenshot: drop an image at docs/screenshot.png and uncomment the line below.

-->

@local/dsh-edge-search README · Why this plugin exists：DSH's built-in `web_fetch` has an SSRF guard: it resolves the hostname once and **rejects the
whole answer set if any resolved address is not public unicast** — before sending a single byte.

Clash / Mihomo style VPNs in **fake-ip** mode (default pool `198.18.0.0/15`, an RFC 2544
reserved range) answer *every* DNS query with a fake address like `198.18.0.107`. The two
designs collide and `web_fetch` fails on **every site** with:

```
URL hostname "..." resolves to a non-public IP address
```

@local/dsh-edge-search README · Why this plugin exists：This is not site-specific. Your network is fine — `curl`, browsers and `Invoke-WebRequest` all
work — but `web_fetch` refuses before it ever dials out.

This plugin sidesteps the check entirely: the browser resolves the name and opens the socket,
the OS routes the traffic into the VPN tunnel. The plugin only reads the rendered page back.

> Quick self-check: `Resolve-DnsName www.baidu.com` on Windows. If it returns `198.18.x.x`,
> fake-ip is on and `web_fetch` is dead for every domain.

---

@local/dsh-edge-search README · Tools：| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `edge_search` | Opens a search-engine results page in a background tab, extracts `title / url / snippet`, closes the tab. Engines: `bing` (default), `baidu`, `google`, `duckduckgo`. |
| `edge_read` | Opens a URL in a background tab, extracts the main readable text with a text-density heuristic (survives most redesigns), closes the tab. |

Both are **text-only and stateless**, never touch your existing tabs, and require **no login**.

@local/dsh-edge-search README · Tools：They are a **fallback channel, not the default one**: an order of magnitude slower than
`web_fetch`. Reach for them only when the built-in tool fails, or when you want to avoid a
billed search API call.

---

@local/dsh-edge-search README · Requirements：- DSH installed (the app or the CLI — either works).
- **Windows** with **Microsoft Edge**. (Another Chromium browser can be forced with `edgePath`.)
- **No npm dependency at runtime**, and no API key.
- To run the offline self-test outside DSH you need **Node.js 22 or newer** — the plugin uses the
  global `WebSocket`, so Node 20 and below fail with `WebSocket is not defined`.
  (DSH ships its own runtime, so this only matters for the standalone self-test.)

@local/dsh-edge-search README · Configuration：Config lives in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, under the `dsh-edge-search` entry:

```yaml
- id: dsh-edge-search
  name: "@local/dsh-edge-search"
  config:
    port: 9222

@local/dsh-edge-search README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `port` | `9222` | CDP port. Must be free. |
| `edgePath` | auto-detected | Path to `msedge.exe`. Set it if Edge is installed somewhere unusual. A path that does not exist raises an explicit error instead of silently falling back to auto-detection. |
| `profileDir` | `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-edge-search\edge-profile` | A separate browser profile used only for automation. Safe to delete when idle. |

@local/dsh-edge-search README · How it works (and the one constraint that matters)：```mermaid flowchart LR A["agent calls edge_read"] --> B["plugin"] B --> C["launch / reuse Edge
with a dedicated profile"] C --> D["create a background tab"] The important part: **DNS resolution and the socket both happen inside the browser**, so the request never passes through DSH's IP check. That is the entire reason this plugin works.
section: How it works (and the one constraint that matters)

text:
@local/dsh-edge-search README · How it works (and the one constraint that matters)：Chromium 136+ **silently ignores** `--remote-debugging-port` when the browser uses its default
data directory. That is why this plugin always launches Edge with a dedicated
`--user-data-dir` instead of trying to attach to your everyday Edge window. Do not "optimise"
that away — remote debugging will simply stop listening with no error.

Each call creates a background tab, does its work, closes the tab. Your own windows are never
touched.

---
section: How it works (and the one constraint that matters)

text:
@local/dsh-edge-search README · Security notes：- **The CDP port binds to `127.0.0.1` only** and does not accept external connections. However,
  **any process on the same machine can connect to it** — worth keeping in mind on a shared or
  untrusted computer. Close the Edge window when you are done.
- **The debug profile is isolated**, at `%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-edge-search\edge-profile`. It holds
  none of your bookmarks, passwords, cookies or sessions. That is also why login-walled pages
  cannot be read — by design, not a bug.
- The plugin **sends no data to any third-party service**. No telemetry, no analytics, no API key.
  Every request goes straight from your browser to the target site.

@local/dsh-edge-search README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `unknown tool "edge_read"` | Plugin not loaded | Installed via option 1? Make sure you **restarted DSH manually**. Otherwise check option 2, step 3 (`bundles`) |
| `edgePath` points at a file that does not exist | Typo in the path | Fix it, or remove the key to fall back to auto-detection |
| `Edge did not expose a debugger on port 9222` | Port taken, or Edge missing | `Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 9222`; set `port` / `edgePath` |
| First call takes 5–10 s | It is launching Edge | Normal. Keep the debug window open; later calls reuse it |
| `extracted no readable text` | JS-only app, login wall, or empty page | Not a bug — nothing to extract |
| Content behind a login | Dedicated profile has no cookies | By design; use your own browser for that |

@local/dsh-edge-search README · Troubleshooting：Expected latency: `edge_read` ≈ 2–10 s, `edge_search` ≈ 3 s, plus 3–8 s on the very first call.

@local/dsh-edge-search README · Companion skill (optional, but recommended)：`skills/web-fallback/SKILL.md` is a DSH skill that tells the agent **when** to reach for these
tools.

**The plugin works without it** — install the plugin and the tools are there. But the agent may
not think to try `edge_read` when `web_fetch` fails. With this skill installed, it switches over
on its own when it hits `WEB_BLOCKED_URL` / `resolves to a non-public IP address`.

@local/dsh-edge-search README · replace D:\tools\dsh-edge-search with wherever you put the plugin：$src = "D:\tools\dsh-edge-search\skills\web-fallback"
$dst = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills\web-fallback"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dst | Out-Null
Copy-Item "$src\SKILL.md" $dst -Force
```
section: replace D:\tools\dsh-edge-search with wherever you put the plugin

text:
@local/dsh-edge-search README · Verify：The layout should look like this:

```
C:\Users\<you>\.dsh\skills\
└── web-fallback\
    └── SKILL.md
```

Then **start a new session** (skills are loaded at session start), and ask "what skills do you
have?" — `web-fallback` should be listed.

@local/dsh-edge-search README · ⚠️ Do not install two copies：If you previously installed a skill with the same purpose but a **different name** (e.g.
`web-fetch-fallback`), **remove the old one first**. Their trigger conditions overlap almost
completely, and having both makes the agent's choice unpredictable.

```powershell
@local/dsh-edge-search README · list what you have：Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills" -Directory | Select-Object Name

@local/dsh-edge-search README · delete the old one once you are sure (name is just an example)：Remove-Item -Recurse -Force "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills\web-fetch-fallback"
```
